movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Malttugi performs a sword dance; Mundung-tal uses expressive gestures of sorrow.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Processional marching through districts and houses, followed by localized performance of the five stories.
movement_profile.partnering: Interaction between characters (e.g., Malttugi and noblemen, Youngno and nobleman).
movement_profile.posture: Varies by character; Mundung-tal uses a posture of lamentation, while Malttugi is active and vigorous.

signature_moves.description: The foundational dance movement style of the Ogwandae players.
signature_moves.name: Dutbegi

signature_moves.description: An active dance with a sword that transitions into a calmer state.
signature_moves.name: Malttugi's Sword Dance

signature_moves.description: A lion dance where a lion consumes a marten, representing the law of the jungle.
signature_moves.name: Sajachum

movement_profile.tempo_feel: Starts active (especially the sword dance) and becomes more calm.
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid treating the satirical mockery of noblemen as mere slapstick; it carries historical weight of social class tension.

music_profile.musical_form: Five-act structure with distinct accompaniment for each story
music_profile.sound_description: The music is characterized by a distinct regional percussion style from the Gyeongsangnam-do province. It features rhythmic accompaniment for the 'dutbegi' dance and includes vocal elements such as Buddhist chants used during the exorcism procession.

teaching.level_notes: Requires mastery of specific character masks and the 'dutbegi' rhythmic bounce.
